_help: Pixel calibration for YOUR character sheet. Save a copy as my/sheet.json next to my/sheet.png (same name, .json). Measure in any image editor (Paint shows the cursor's x,y at the bottom). Then run: .venv/Scripts/python skills/anime-talking-short/scripts/build_poses.py --check my/sheet.png and look at my/sheet-check.png.
_BOX: x0, y0, x1, y1 of the CLOSED-mouth figure on the sheet. MOUTH and TPL below are measured inside this box (subtract x0, y0).
_MOUTH: centre of the closed lip line, inside BOX.
_FACE_UP: pixels from the lip line up to the centre of the face (about the nose bridge).
_FACE_W: face width in pixels (ear to ear). The camera frames close-ups from this.
_TPL: x0, y0, x1, y1 inside BOX around the mouth area (lips plus any mustache or beard). The importer finds this patch in every pose.
_ART: x0, y0, x1, y1 on the WHOLE sheet around the OPEN mouth of the second figure. Its art becomes the talking mouth shapes.
_SEED: a pixel inside the dark interior of that open mouth, measured inside ART.
_colours: LIP = lip colour, LINE = outline colour, DARK = mouth interior colour (RGB).
